title: Rollout-Time Intervention: Unlocking Agentic Reinforcement Learning Beyond Policy Limits
title_zh: 部署时干预：突破策略限制，释放智能体强化学习的潜力

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a key paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) agents, enabling stronger reasoning, planning, and tool-use in interactive environments. However, existing agent RL methods remain fundamentally constrained by an on-policy reasoning bottleneck: when tasks exceed the model’s current capability boundary, effective trajectories become extremely sparse and training often collapses. We introduce Rollout-Time Intervention (RTI) , a technique designed to elicit successful trajectories beyond the policy’s intrinsic exploration capacity. RTI operates by leveraging reward-side evidence (i.e., evaluation rubrics) during rollout to convert erroneous trajectories into successful ones, providing effective learning signals for tasks that the policy rarely solves on its own. Although intervention trajectories are inherently off-policy, we find that they can effectively guide policy optimization when trajectories with excessive distributional shifts are filtered out. Extensive experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that RTI consistently outperforms RL baselines, enabling the post-trained policy to approach the performance of substantially stronger contemporary LLMs and, more importantly, transcend its original capability boundary. The code is available at https://github.com/Alibaba-NLP/qqr .
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习（RL）已成为提升大型语言模型（LLM）智能体的关键范式，使其在交互式环境中具备更强的推理、规划和工具使用能力。 然而，现有的智能体强化学习方法仍受到“在线策略推理瓶颈”的根本性限制：当任务超出模型当前能力边界时，有效轨迹会变得极其稀疏，训练过程也常常失效。 我们提出了“展开时间干预”（Rollout-Time Intervention, RTI）技术，旨在激发策略内在探索能力之外的成功轨迹。 RTI 通过在展开阶段利用奖励侧的证据（即评估标准），将错误轨迹转化为成功轨迹，从而为策略自身极少能独立解决的任务提供有效的学习信号。 尽管干预轨迹本质上属于离线策略，但我们发现，只要过滤掉分布偏移过大的轨迹，它们就能有效指导策略优化。 在五个基准数据集上进行的大量实验表明，RTI 始终优于强化学习基线方法，使后训练策略的性能接近当前更强大的大型语言模型，更重要的是，能够突破其原有的能力边界。 代码可在 https://github.com/Alibaba-NLP/qqr 获取。

paragraphs.en: LLMs are rapidly evolving from static instruction-following systems into interactive agents that can collaborate with external environments to achieve goals ( Team, 2026 ; Froger et al., 2025 ) . RL has been a key driver of this shift, enabling advanced capabilities such as self-reflection and long-horizon planning ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Qian et al., 2026 ) . These advances have fueled strong performance in challenging agent settings, including mathematical reasoning with code interpreters ( Feng et al., 2025 ) , deep research with search engines ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) , and complex real-world tool use ( Qian et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Dong et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: LLM 正迅速从静态的指令遵循系统演变为交互式智能体，这些智能体能够与外部环境协作以实现目标（Team, 2026；Froger 等, 2025）。 强化学习一直是这一转变的关键驱动力，它促成了自我反思和长期规划等高级能力的出现（Guo 等, 2025；Qian 等, 2026）。 这些进步推动了智能体在复杂场景中的卓越表现，包括借助代码解释器进行数学推理（Feng 等, 2025）、利用搜索引擎开展深度研究（Jin 等, 2025；Sun 等, 2026），以及复杂的现实世界工具使用（Qian 等, 2026；Gao 等, 2026；Yang 等, 2026；Dong 等, 2026b；Li 等, 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Nevertheless, standard RL is limited by its on-policy nature: it mainly amplifies behaviors already supported by the current policy, rather than inducing new reasoning patterns ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Yue et al., 2026 ) . As a result, when tasks lie beyond the model’s capability boundary, successful trajectories become extremely sparse, leading to unstable training or even collapse (Figure 1 (a)). Teacher-guided methods such as LUFFY ( Yan et al., 2026 ) and OPD ( Lu & Thinking Machines Lab, 2025 ) can partially mitigate this issue, but their improvements remain bounded by teacher capability.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，标准强化学习受其在线策略特性的限制：它主要放大当前策略已经支持的行为，而非引导出新的推理模式（Zhao 等人，2025；Yue 等人，2026）。 因此，当任务超出模型的能力边界时，成功的路径会变得极其稀疏，导致训练不稳定甚至崩溃（图 1(a)）。 LUFFY（Yan 等人，2026）和 OPD（Lu 与 Thinking Machines Lab，2025）等教师引导方法可以在一定程度上缓解这一问题，但其改进效果仍受限于教师的能力。

paragraphs.en: To further understand these failures, we examine failed agent trajectories and find a recurring pattern: the agent often possesses the knowledge and tools needed to complete the task, but makes a small early reasoning or action error at a task-critical step. As illustrated in Figure 1 , in τ 2 \tau^{2} -Telecom, the agent must guide the user to invoke a user-side tool, yet the model may incorrectly treat it as an agent-accessible tool and repeatedly attempt to call it; in Navigation, user queries are often ambiguous, and the agent must interpret noisy POI search results in the context of the user’s intent rather than blindly treating a returned POI as the target. In both cases, a single incorrect interaction strategy can steer subsequent reasoning into a failure loop, while correcting this early decision is often sufficient for the remaining trajectory to proceed normally. These observations motivate us: if such early reasoning errors can be corrected so that the rollout succeeds, can RL learn from these corrected trajectories and thereby push the policy beyond its original reasoning limits (Figure 1 (c))?
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步理解这些失败，我们分析了失败智能体的轨迹，发现了一种重复出现的模式：智能体通常具备完成任务所需的知识与工具，但在任务的关键步骤中，却会在早期的推理或行动中犯下一个小错误。 如图 1 所示，在 τ₂ -Telecom 任务中，智能体必须引导用户调用用户端的工具，但模型可能会错误地将其视为智能体可访问的工具，并反复尝试调用它；而在导航任务中，用户的查询往往模棱两可，智能体必须结合用户的意图来解读嘈杂的兴趣点（POI）搜索结果，而不是盲目地将返回的某个兴趣点视为目标。 在这两种情况下，仅一个错误的互动策略就可能使后续的推理陷入失败循环，而纠正这一早期决策通常足以让剩余轨迹正常进行。 这些观察结果启发我们：如果这类早期的推理错误能够得到纠正，从而使执行过程成功，那么强化学习能否从这些被纠正的轨迹中学习，并借此将策略的推理能力超越其原有极限（图 1(c)）？

paragraphs.en: However, such intervention introduces a central technical challenge: the corrected trajectories are no longer sampled from the original policy, but generated by an intervention-induced behavior policy. This discrepancy poses two fundamental risks. First, privileged reward-side information may leak into the reasoning process, producing shortcut-driven or behaviorally implausible trajectories that could not arise under genuine task interaction. Second, intervention may induce substantial distributional shifts from the original policy. In PPO-style optimization, including GRPO, such shifts can push importance ratios beyond the clipping range, suppressing otherwise useful learning signals, while low-probability actions may yield high-variance gradients that destabilize training.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这种干预引入了一个核心的技术挑战：修正后的轨迹不再来自原始策略的采样，而是由干预所引发的行为策略生成的。 这种差异带来了两个根本性的风险。 首先，特权化的奖励侧信息可能会渗透到推理过程中，从而产生依赖捷径或行为上不合逻辑的轨迹，而这些轨迹在真实的任务交互中是不可能出现的。 其次，干预可能会导致与原始策略相比显著的分布偏移。 在类 PPO 的优化方法（包括 GRPO）中，这类偏移可能使重要性比率超出裁剪范围，抑制原本有用的学习信号；同时，低概率的动作可能会产生高方差的梯度，从而破坏训练的稳定性。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we propose Rollout-Time Intervention (RTI) , comprising three components: (1) reward-aware multi-agent intervention , which employs a Validator–Corrector–Verifier pipeline to transform failed rollouts into successful intervention trajectories while preventing privileged-information leakage; (2) perplexity-based distribution gating , which filters intervened trajectories that deviate excessively from the current policy; and (3) reasoning-shift-aware token reweighting , which concentrates policy updates on critical tokens where intervention induces substantial strategy changes. Together, these components enable stable learning from successful trajectories beyond the policy’s unaided exploration capacity, thereby pushing the policy beyond its original capability boundary. Experiments on public and real-world benchmarks show that RTI substantially outperforms baselines and achieves a breakthrough in the boundaries of reasoning capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们提出了“部署时间干预”（Rollout-Time Intervention, RTI），它包含三个组成部分：（1）奖励感知的多智能体干预，该部分采用“验证器–校正器–核实器”流程，将失败的部署转化为成功的干预轨迹，同时防止特权信息泄露；（2）基于困惑度的分布门控，用于过滤那些偏离当前策略过大的干预轨迹；以及（3）推理转换感知的令牌重新加权，将策略更新集中在关键令牌上，因为这些令牌是干预引发显著策略变化的位置。 这些组成部分共同作用，使得智能体能够利用成功的轨迹进行稳定学习，其能力超越了策略本身无辅助探索的极限，从而推动策略突破原有的能力边界。 在公开数据集和真实世界基准上的实验表明，RTI 的性能显著优于基线方法，并在推理能力的边界上实现了突破。

paragraphs.en: (i) Data-synthesis-driven SFT improves tool use by generating interaction trajectories for supervised fine-tuning, including ToolLLM ( Qin et al., 2024 ) , ToolACE ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , APIGen-MT ( Prabhakar et al., 2026 ) , TopoCurate ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , and simulation or self-evolving pipelines for multi-turn data generation ( Li et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) . More recently, AEPO ( Dong et al., 2026a ) further improves optimization stability under long-horizon, multi-turn tool use through entropy-aware policy updates.

paragraphs.en: Teacher-Guided Training for LLMs. When tasks lie beyond the model’s capability boundary, successful rollouts become extremely sparse and the policy is rarely exposed to truly corrective trajectories. To alleviate this, recent work studies teacher-guided training in two forms. One line provides token-level credit assignment using stronger teachers, often via trajectory-level teacher-student KL to derive dense rewards ( Gu et al., 2024 ; Lu & Thinking Machines Lab, 2025 ) . Another line introduces off-policy successful trajectories : LUFFY ( Yan et al., 2026 ) , for instance, combines offline expert data with online rollouts and uses importance sampling to handle distribution shift.
paragraphs.zh: 教师引导式的大语言模型训练。 当任务超出模型的能力边界时，成功的执行过程会极为罕见，策略也很少能接触到真正具有纠正作用的轨迹。 为缓解这一问题，近期的研究从两种形式探讨了教师引导式训练。 一种方法通过更强的教师进行词元级别的信用分配，通常借助轨迹级别的教师-学生 KL 散度来生成密集奖励（Gu et al., 2024；Lu & Thinking Machines Lab, 2025）。 另一种方法则引入了离策略的成功轨迹：例如，LUFFY（Yan et al., 2026）将离线专家数据与在线执行过程相结合，并利用重要性采样来处理分布偏移问题。

paragraphs.en: To overcome the exploration bottleneck of on-policy RL, we propose RTI , a technique comprising three components as shown in Figure 2 . First, reward-aware multi-agent system (MAS) intervention calibrates task-critical errors at the step level, transforming failed rollouts into successful intervention trajectories while preventing privileged-information leakage. Second, perplexity-based distribution gating filters interventions that deviate excessively from the rollout policy, mitigating ineffective or unstable updates caused by severe off-policy shifts. Third, reasoning-shift-aware token reweighting emphasizes the critical tokens responsible for intervention-induced strategy changes, enabling more precise credit assignment. Together, these components enable stable learning from successful trajectories beyond the policy’s unaided exploration capacity.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决在线策略强化学习中的探索瓶颈问题，我们提出了 RTI——一种包含三个组件的技术，如图 2 所示。 首先，奖励感知多智能体系统（MAS）干预可在步骤层面校准任务关键性错误，将失败的执行过程转化为成功的干预轨迹，同时防止特权信息泄露。 其次，基于困惑度的分布门控机制可过滤那些与执行策略偏离过大的干预措施，从而减轻因严重偏离策略而导致的无效或不稳定的更新。 第三，推理偏移感知令牌重新加权机制会强调那些引发策略变化的关键令牌，从而实现更精确的功劳分配。 这些组件共同作用，使得系统能够基于成功的轨迹进行稳定学习，其能力超越了策略本身无辅助探索所能达到的范围。

paragraphs.en: The validator identifies whether the current rollout step has harmfully deviated from a valid path to the gold outcome. Given the query x x and the observable history before step k k : h 1 : k − 1 = ( z 1 , a 1 , o 1 , … , z k − 1 , a k − 1 , o k − 1 ) h_{1:k-1}=(z_{1},a_{1},o_{1},\dots,z_{k-1},a_{k-1},o_{k-1}) , the current response u ^ k \hat{u}_{k} , and the reward-side evidence ℓ \ell , it determines whether u ^ k := ( z k , a k ) \hat{u}_{k}:=(z_{k},a_{k}) is still compatible with successful task completion. Importantly, the validator is reward-oriented rather than process-prescriptive: it does not penalize suboptimal but recoverable decisions, alternative valid action orders, or stylistic differences, and instead flags only those errors that are likely to derail the trajectory. In this way, the validator detects only task-critical mistakes, matching our central motivation that many rollout failures arise from early local errors rather than missing end-task capability. paragraphs.en: Benchmarks. We evaluate RTI across five benchmarks. First, we construct Navigation , a multi-waypoint navigation benchmark derived from real-world map scenarios, where agents must plan routes and complete tasks by interacting with real APIs from the Amap Open Platform. Second, we adopt the publicly available multi-turn dialogue benchmark τ 2 \tau^{2} -Bench ( Barres et al., 2025 ) and evaluate on its Telecom , Retail , and Airline domains. The corresponding RL training instances are drawn from the AReaL dataset ( Fu et al., 2026 ) . Finally, we consider Claw-Eval ( Ye et al., 2026 ) , a human-verified benchmark comprising highly diverse tasks grounded in real-world environments. To evaluate whether RTI can improve performance beyond the policy’s native capabilities, we select 20 challenging T-series tasks on which the base policy rarely succeeds, forming Claw-Eval-Hard20 , and synthesize task-specific training data for these tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试。 我们在五个基准测试上评估 RTI。 首先，我们构建了一个名为 Navigation 的多点导航基准测试，该测试源自真实世界的地图场景，智能体必须规划路线，并通过与 Amap Open Platform 的真实 API 交互来完成任务。 其次，我们采用了公开可用的多轮对话基准测试 τ 2 \tau^{2} -Bench（Barres 等人，2025），并在其 Telecom、Retail 和 Airline 领域进行评估。 相应的强化学习训练实例来自 AReaL 数据集（Fu 等人，2026）。 最后，我们考虑了 Claw-Eval（Ye 等人，2026），这是一个经过人类验证的基准测试，包含基于真实世界环境的多样化任务。 为了评估 RTI 能否在策略原生能力之外进一步提升性能，我们选择了 20 个具有挑战性的 T-series 任务——基础策略在这些任务上很少成功——组成了 Claw-Eval-Hard20，并为这些任务合成了特定的训练数据。

paragraphs.en: Tables 1 and 2 show that RTI consistently improves agent performance, with the largest gains on tasks where the backbone and existing RL methods struggle. Three findings stand out.

paragraphs.en: First, RTI overcomes bottlenecks in domain-specific interaction. With Qwen3-8B, RTI improves Pass@1 over GRPO by 24.56 points on τ 2 \tau^{2} -Telecom and 22.00 points on Navigation. Telecom requires the agent to guide users through actions it cannot perform itself; Navigation requires it to recognize noisy POI results and refine its search before requesting directions. Corrected rollouts expose the policy to successful strategies for both failure modes (Appendix C.2 ).

paragraphs.en: To isolate each component’s contribution, we conduct ablation studies on Navigation and τ 2 \tau^{2} -Telecom with Qwen3-8B, evaluating three variants: RTI w/o Post-Check , which removes the Integrity-Constrained Intervention Verifier ; RTI w/o PPL Gating , which removes the PPL-Based Distribution Gating ; and RTI w/o Reweight , which removes the Reasoning-Shift-Aware Token Reweighting .
paragraphs.zh: 为隔离各组件的贡献，我们在 Navigation 和 τ 2 \tau^{2} -Telecom 任务上对 Qwen3-8B 进行了消融研究，评估了三种变体：RTI w/o Post-Check（移除完整性约束干预验证器）、RTI w/o PPL Gating（移除基于 PPL 的分布门控）以及 RTI w/o Reweight（移除推理转移感知令牌重新加权）。

paragraphs.en: Effect of Post-Check. Removing the Post-Check leads to a large degradation on both benchmarks. On τ 2 \tau^{2} -Telecom, the variant loses almost all of RTI’s gains and falls back to the GRPO level; on Navigation, it even drops below GRPO (26.00 vs. 35.33 in Pass@1). Without integrity verification, the admitted interventions are frequently leak-contaminated or otherwise unlearnable, and the corrupted supervision can actively harm the policy rather than merely fail to help. A representative failure case is given in Appendix D.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 后置检查的影响。 移除后置检查会导致两个基准测试的性能大幅下降。 在 τ 2 \tau^{2} -Telecom 上，该变体几乎完全失去了 RTI 带来的所有增益，并回落到 GRPO 水平；而在 Navigation 上，其表现甚至低于 GRPO（Pass@1 为 26.00，而 GRPO 为 35.33）。 如果没有完整性验证，被接受的干预措施通常会受到泄露污染或无法学习，而受损的监督机制可能会主动损害策略，而不仅仅是无法提供帮助。 附录 D.2 中给出了一个典型的失败案例。

paragraphs.en: We further study the gating threshold δ \delta in the PPL-based distribution gating (Section 4.2 , Eq. ( 4 )), which controls the maximum deviation from the rollout policy that an intervened response may exhibit before being discarded. We sweep δ ∈ { 0 , 3 , 5 , 20 , + ∞ } \delta\in\{0,3,5,20,+\infty\} on Navigation with the Qwen3-8B backbone. At one extreme ( δ = 0 \delta=0 ), the gate rejects all interventions, so training falls back to the no-intervention limit; at the other ( δ = + ∞ \delta=+\infty ), no filtering is applied at all.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步研究了基于PPL的分布门控（第4.2节，公式(4)）中的门控阈值δ，该阈值控制着被干预响应在丢弃之前允许偏离展开策略的最大偏差。我们在Navigation任务上，使用Qwen3-8B作为主干模型，对δ ∈ {0, 3, 5, 20, +∞}进行了系统性扫描。在一个极端情况下（δ = 0），门控会拒绝所有干预，因此训练将退化为无干预的极限情况；而在另一个极端情况下（δ = +∞），则完全不进行任何过滤。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 3 , the two extremes behave as expected: with δ = 0 \delta=0 , training degenerates into the GRPO run and the success rate stays nearly flat, whereas δ = + ∞ \delta=+\infty improves steadily but converges to a clearly lower level. Performance improves as δ \delta grows from 3 3 to 5 5 and degrades at δ = 20 \delta=20 : a threshold that is too small discards too many corrective trajectories to sustain late-stage gains, while a threshold that is too large admits severely shifted interventions, whose low-probability, high-variance updates destabilize optimization—the δ = 20 \delta=20 curve indeed exhibits the highest volatility among all runs. The best trade-off is achieved at δ = 5 \delta=5 , which preserves informative corrections while filtering out excessively deviated ones: it tracks δ = 3 \delta=3 closely in early training, pulls ahead in later stages, and converges to the highest final success rate. We therefore adopt δ = 5 \delta=5 in all experiments.

paragraphs.en: Training Dynamics Comparison. Figure 4 compares evaluation Pass@4 (solid lines) with training rollout Pass@8 (dashed lines) on Navigation. All curves are Gaussian-smoothed for visualization. For RTI, the two dashed curves measure rollout success before and after intervention. The large gap at early stage between them shows that intervention converts many failed rollout groups into successful trajectories, providing training signals where GRPO receives few. Crucially, RTI’s pre-intervention Pass@8 also rises over training and exceeds GRPO’s rollout success, while its evaluation Pass@4 improves in tandem. Thus, the corrected trajectories support effective policy updates: the model increasingly succeeds without intervention, rather than relying on intervention only at rollout time.
paragraphs.zh: 训练动态对比。 图 4 比较了导航任务中评估的 Pass@4（实线）与训练展开过程中的 Pass@8（虚线）。 所有曲线均经过高斯平滑处理，以方便可视化。 对于 RTI，两条虚线曲线分别衡量干预前后展开过程的成功率。 早期阶段两者之间的显著差距表明，干预将许多失败的展开组转化为成功轨迹，从而在 GRPO 接收较少训练信号的地方提供了训练信号。 关键在于，RTI 的干预前 Pass@8 在训练过程中同样上升，并超过了 GRPO 的展开成功率，同时其评估 Pass@4 也同步提升。 因此，这些修正后的轨迹支持了有效的策略更新：模型无需干预即可取得越来越高的成功率，而不再仅仅依赖展开时刻的干预。

paragraphs.en: Dynamics of Intervened-Step Perplexity and Reasoning Patterns. To further verify whether the intervened behaviors are truly internalized by the policy, we examine the average PPL under the policy model per successful intervened step, which measures the distributional gap between the intervened trajectory and the policy’s native generation distribution. As shown in Figure 5 , the curve drops steadily during training: those that are still triggered yield intervened responses that are increasingly close to the policy’s own output distribution. It provides direct evidence that the policy is not merely exploiting the intervention at training time but is actually absorbing the intervened reasoning pattern into its native behavior. Additionally, we analyze Navigation to examine how training under RTI versus GRPO changes the model’s resulting reasoning patterns . Figure 5 contrasts the per-iteration distribution of interaction turns under GRPO and RTI on Navigation. Compared with GRPO, RTI maintains a broader and more multi-modal turn distribution throughout training. In particular, trajectories exceeding 3 turns continue to retain non-trivial mass even at later stages, indicating that the policy preserves the capacity for self-reflective re-querying rather than collapsing into a single short interaction template. A case is provided in Appendix D.4 .

paragraphs.en: Generalization Across Hard Agent Tasks. All preceding RTI experiments use self-intervention. To examine whether a stronger intervening model improves learning, we additionally use Qwen3.5-397B-A17B to correct rollouts from the Qwen3.5-9B policy. Figure 6 compares this variant with standard RTI and GRPO on Claw-Eval-Hard20. GRPO improves briefly before its Pass@ k k and Pass k scores collapse. Both RTI variants instead sustain gains across the two metric families: higher Pass@ k k reflects success on more tasks within k k attempts, while higher Pass k reflects more consistent success across attempts. Standard RTI achieves the strongest results, showing that corrections from the much larger model deviate further from the policy’s distribution and are therefore harder to learn from, despite the teacher’s greater capability. These findings show that self-intervention suffices to improve performance across diverse hard tasks without relying on a stronger teacher. Additionally, we supplement the experimental results on the full set of unimodal (text-only) tasks in Appendix D.6 .

paragraphs.en: We introduced RTI to enable agent policies to learn beyond their unaided exploration capacity. RTI uses reward-aware self-intervention to correct failed rollouts, a perplexity-based gate to filter excessively shifted trajectories, and reasoning-shift-aware token reweighting to focus policy updates on consequential decisions. Across five benchmarks and two backbones, RTI substantially improves task success, with particularly large gains on Navigation, τ 2 \tau^{2} -Telecom, and Claw-Eval-Hard20. Training analyses show that intervention supplies successful trajectories early in training and that the policy increasingly succeeds without intervention as learning proceeds. An additional comparison using a much larger intervening model confirms that RTI does not require a stronger teacher to achieve these gains, supporting its applicability across diverse agent tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们引入了 RTI，使智能体策略能够超越其无辅助探索能力的限制进行学习。 RTI 利用奖励感知的自我干预来纠正失败的执行过程，采用基于困惑度的门控机制过滤过度偏移的轨迹，并通过感知推理偏移的令牌重新加权，将策略更新聚焦于具有关键影响的决策。 在五个基准测试和两种基础模型中，RTI 显著提升了任务成功率，尤其在导航、τ 2 \tau^{2} -Telecom 和 Claw-Eval-Hard20 任务上取得了尤为显著的进步。 训练分析表明，干预机制在训练初期提供了成功的轨迹，而随着学习过程的推进，策略逐渐能够在无需干预的情况下取得成功。 使用一个规模大得多的干预模型进行的额外比较证实，RTI 无需更强大的教师模型即可实现这些提升，这支持了其在多样化智能体任务中的适用性。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we present the full prompt templates for the three MAS agents used in RTI.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们介绍了 RTI 中使用的三种 MAS 智能体的完整提示模板。

paragraphs.en: The Validator assesses whether the current response is a valid next step that keeps the agent on track. It checks against a set of hard rules and marks the response invalid only when a clear violation is detected.
paragraphs.zh: 验证器会评估当前响应是否是一个有效的后续步骤，能够确保智能体保持在正确轨道上。 它会对照一系列硬性规则进行检查，只有在检测到明确违规时，才会将响应标记为无效。

sents.en: It checks against a set of hard rules and marks the response invalid only when a clear violation is detected.
sents.zh: 它会对照一系列硬性规则进行检查，只有在检测到明确违规时，才会将响应标记为无效。

paragraphs.en: The Corrector generates an optimized next action that corrects errors while concealing privileged information. It receives the Validator’s diagnosis together with the visible-only conversation history and produces an intervened response.
paragraphs.zh: 校正器会生成一个优化的后续动作，在纠正错误的同时隐藏特权信息。 它会接收验证器的诊断结果以及仅可见的对话历史，并生成一个经过干预的响应。

paragraphs.en: The Verifier validates that the corrected response does not leak privileged information or introduce hallucinated content. It serves as the final quality gate before an intervened response enters the training batch.
paragraphs.zh: 验证器会核实修正后的响应是否未泄露特权信息或引入幻觉内容。 在经干预的响应进入训练批次之前，它充当最终的质量关卡。

paragraphs.en: The Navigation domain follows the same three-agent Validate–Correct–Verify pipeline as τ 2 \tau^{2} -Bench, sharing the identical architectural logic: the Validator detects deviations from a valid path using the reward-side evidence as a silent reference; the Corrector applies the same four generation principles (style alignment, progressive correction, leakage suppression, minimal intervention); and the Verifier enforces the same integrity constraints (no leakage, no hallucination).
paragraphs.zh: 导航领域遵循与 τ 2 \tau^{2} -Bench 相同的三智能体「验证–修正–核实」流程，并共享完全一致的建筑逻辑：验证器利用奖励侧的证据作为隐性参考，检测偏离有效路径的情况；修正器应用相同的四项生成原则（风格对齐、渐进式修正、抑制信息泄露、最小干预）；而核实器则强制执行相同的完整性约束（无信息泄露、无幻觉）。

paragraphs.en: The Navigation Validator applies the same goal-oriented, process-agnostic philosophy as its τ 2 \tau^{2} -Bench counterpart: it does not penalize suboptimal-but-recoverable action orders or stylistic differences, and only flags violations of the hard rules already stated in the agent’s system prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 导航验证器采用了与其 τ 2 \tau^{2} -Bench 对应版本相同的目标导向、过程无关的理念：它不会因次优但可恢复的行动顺序或风格差异而进行惩罚，仅会标记智能体系统提示中已明确说明的硬性规则的违反情况。

paragraphs.en: The Navigation Corrector shares the same four generation principles as τ 2 \tau^{2} -Bench (style alignment, progressive correction, leakage suppression, minimal intervention).
paragraphs.zh: 导航校正器与 τ 2 \tau^{2}-Bench 遵循相同的四项生成原则（风格对齐、渐进式校正、泄漏抑制、最小干预）。

paragraphs.en: The Navigation Verifier enforces the same two core rejection criteria as the τ 2 \tau^{2} -Bench Verifier—leakage of privileged information and hallucination of underivable content.
paragraphs.zh: 导航验证器强制执行与 τ 2 \tau^{2}-基准验证器相同的两项核心拒绝标准：泄露特权信息以及凭空生成无法推导出的内容。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 integrates the intervention pipeline and the on-policy GRPO loop into a single training procedure. At every iteration we sample a batch of queries from 𝒟 \mathcal{D} and, for each query, first run a fully on-policy GRPO group; if any rollout in this group succeeds, the group is used as-is and only the on-policy portion of 𝒥 RTI \mathcal{J}_{\mathrm{RTI}} is exercised (with ρ ~ cal t ≡ 1 \tilde{\rho}_{\mathrm{cal}}^{t}\equiv 1 ). Only when the entire group fails do we re-run an intervened rollout with the MAS intervention pipeline enabled; every accepted correction must additionally pass the perplexity gate of Eq. ( 4 ), and only if the intervened rollout succeeds is a single failed member of the group replaced by the intervened trajectory, for which we additionally cache the rollout-prompt and correction-prompt logprobs needed by Eq. ( 7 ). A single backward pass over 𝒥 RTI \mathcal{J}_{\mathrm{RTI}} then updates θ \theta with a gradient that is on-policy on easy instances, reweighted on intervened tokens of hard instances, and unbiased on every other token. This design preserves GRPO’s behavior whenever the policy can solve a task on its own and adds capability-expanding signals exactly where vanilla on-policy RL stalls.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 将干预流程与在线策略 GRPO 循环整合为单一的训练过程。 在每个迭代中，我们从 𝒟 \mathcal{D} 中采样一批查询，并对每个查询首先运行一个完全在线策略的 GRPO 组；如果该组中的任何一次展开成功，则直接使用该组，且仅执行 𝒥 RTI \mathcal{J}_{\mathrm{RTI}} 的在线策略部分（此时 ρ ~ cal t ≡ 1 \tilde{\rho}_{\mathrm{cal}}^{t}\equiv 1）。 只有当整个组都失败时，我们才会重新运行一次启用了 MAS 干预流程的干预展开；每次被接受的修正还必须通过公式 (4) 中的困惑度门限。 并且仅当干预展开成功时，才会用干预轨迹替换该组中单个失败的成员，同时我们还会额外缓存公式 (7) 所需的展开提示和修正提示的对数概率。 随后对 𝒥 RTI \mathcal{J}_{\mathrm{RTI}} 进行一次反向传播，即可更新 θ \theta，其梯度在简单实例上保持在线策略特性，在困难实例的干预标记上经过重新加权，并在所有其他标记上保持无偏。 这种设计在策略能够独立完成任务时保留了 GRPO 的行为，并恰好在传统在线策略强化学习陷入停滞的位置增加了能力扩展的信号。

paragraphs.en: RTI differs from standard on-policy GRPO in two aspects: it incorporates MAS-intervened trajectories, which are off-policy relative to the current policy, and it further applies the reasoning-shift-aware token reweighting in Eq. paragraphs.en: The Navigation benchmark evaluates the agent’s ability to construct a valid multi-waypoint route plan given a natural-language user query. Given a query x x (e.g., “How do I drive from Dajin Park to Lihui Park, and then to Yixing Temple?”), the agent must: (1) issue one or more poi_search calls to resolve each mentioned location name to its geographic coordinates, and (2) invoke direction with the correctly assembled origin, destination, and intermediate waypoints to produce the final route. The agent must respect a strict sequential constraint: direction can only be called after all necessary POI coordinates have been retrieved via prior tool calls.
paragraphs.zh: 导航基准测试评估智能体在给定自然语言用户查询时构建有效多途经点路线计划的能力。 给定一个查询 x x（例如，“如何从大金公园开车到利辉公园，然后再去宜兴寺？”），智能体必须：(1) 发出一次或多次 poi_search 调用，将每个提到的地点名称解析为其地理坐标；以及 (2) 使用正确组合的起点、终点和中间途经点调用 direction，以生成最终路线。 智能体必须遵守严格的顺序约束：只有在通过先前的工具调用获取了所有必要的 POI 坐标之后，才能调用 direction。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation criterion is exact parameter matching of the direction call . Each query is annotated with an order level (0–4) that specifies the visit-sequence constraint imposed by the user’s intent: Order 0 (free ordering among all waypoints), Order 1 (fixed start, free remainder), Order 2 (fixed end, free remainder), Order 3 (fixed start and end, flexible middle), and Order 4 (strict sequential order matching the query’s surface order). The matching rule is order-level-aware: for Order 0, any permutation of intermediate waypoints that yields the correct set is accepted; for Order 4, the waypoints list must match the ground-truth in exact sequence. The agent’s final direction invocation must match the ground-truth call in its origin , destination , and waypoints fields at the coordinate level under the corresponding order constraint. A trajectory receives reward = 1 \textsc{reward}=1 if and only if all fields match; otherwise reward = 0 \textsc{reward}=0 with no partial credit. Maximum interaction turns are set to 6 per episode. We report Pass@ k k and Pass k for k = 1 , … , 4 k=1,\ldots,4 .
paragraphs.zh: 评估标准是方向调用的参数完全匹配。 每个查询都标注了一个订单级别（0–4），用于指定用户意图所施加的访问顺序约束：订单 0（所有途经点之间顺序自由）、订单 1（起点固定，其余顺序自由）、订单 2（终点固定，其余顺序自由）、订单 3（起点和终点固定，中间顺序灵活）以及订单 4（严格遵循查询表面顺序的序列匹配）。 匹配规则会考虑订单级别：对于订单 0，只要生成的途经点集合正确，任何排列方式均可接受；对于订单 4，途经点列表必须与真实数据完全按相同顺序匹配。 智能体最终的方向调用必须在相应的订单约束下，在起点、终点和途经点字段上与真实数据的调用在坐标级别完全匹配。 当且仅当所有字段完全匹配时，轨迹才能获得奖励 = 1 \textsc{reward}=1；否则奖励 = 0 \textsc{reward}=0，且无部分得分。 每集的最大交互轮数设为 6。 我们报告 Pass@ k k 和 Pass k 的结果，其中 k = 1 , … , 4 k=1,\ldots,4 。

paragraphs.en: To synthesize user queries with deterministic, evaluator-checkable ground-truth routes, we adopt an inverse construction protocol: rather than annotating routes for given queries, we first sample geographically coherent waypoint sets from the map and then synthesize the natural-language query that would induce that route. The pipeline proceeds in three stages.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将用户查询与确定且可被评估者验证的真实路线相结合，我们采用了一种逆向构建协议：而不是为给定的查询标注路线，我们首先从地图中采样出地理上连贯的路点集合，然后合成能够引导出该路线的自然语言查询。 该流程分为三个阶段进行。

sents.en: To synthesize user queries with deterministic, evaluator-checkable ground-truth routes, we adopt an inverse construction protocol: rather than annotating routes for given queries, we first sample geographically coherent waypoint sets from the map and then synthesize the natural-language query that would induce that route.
sents.zh: 为了将用户查询与确定且可被评估者验证的真实路线相结合，我们采用了一种逆向构建协议：而不是为给定的查询标注路线，我们首先从地图中采样出地理上连贯的路点集合，然后合成能够引导出该路线的自然语言查询。

sents.en: The pipeline proceeds in three stages.
sents.zh: 该流程分为三个阶段进行。

paragraphs.en: Stage 1 – Spatially-anchored waypoint sampling. We seed each instance from a single anchor POI drawn uniformly at random from a corpus of Amap reverse-geocoding records, and issue an around_search request centered at the anchor with a 50 ​ km 50\,\mathrm{km} radius, restricted to the “scenic spots” category. From the returned candidates we retain a random subset of n ∼ 𝒰 ​ { 3 , 9 } n\sim\mathcal{U}\{3,9\} POIs, which jointly form the reference waypoint set of the instance and induce the ground-truth direction call. Two design choices are worth emphasizing. First, anchoring all waypoints around a common spatial seed enforces geographic coherence : the resulting waypoint set is realizable as a single trip rather than a random mixture of POIs from disparate regions. Second, randomizing the cardinality n n from 3 3 to 9 9 exposes the agent to a wide spectrum of long-horizon planning lengths, which is the dominant complexity dimension on this benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 1 – 空间锚定的路径点采样。 我们从 Amap 反向地理编码记录库中均匀随机抽取单个锚定兴趣点（POI）作为每个实例的种子，并以该锚点为中心发出半径为 50 km 的 around_search 请求，结果限制在“景点”类别内。 从返回的候选项中，我们保留一个大小为 n ∼ 𝒰 { 3 , 9 } 的随机子集兴趣点（POI），这些 POI 共同构成该实例的参考路径点集合，并由此推导出真实方向判断。 有两个设计选择值得强调。 首先，将所有路径点锚定在同一个空间种子周围，可以确保地理上的连贯性：这样生成的路径点集合能够作为一次行程实现，而不是来自不同地区的兴趣点的随机混合。 其次，将基数 n 从 3 到 9 进行随机化，能让智能体接触到多种长期规划的长度范围，而这正是该基准测试中主要的复杂性维度。

paragraphs.en: The prompt states only that the generated question must request a route passing through the supplied waypoints and explicitly encourages colloquial paraphrase to widen the query distribution. paragraphs.en: Stage 3 – LLM filtering. Stage 2 produces noisy (query, reference) pairs that are not directly usable: the synthesized query may underspecify, over-specify, or paraphrase away one of the waypoints, and the spatially-sampled reference set may itself contain outliers that no human traveller would bundle into a single trip. We therefore apply an LLM-based semantic verifier (prompt shown below) that judges whether the query unambiguously requests routing through exactly the reference waypoints — with no spurious destinations and no missing waypoints — and whether the reference set is geographically plausible as one continuous trip; pairs failing either check are discarded.

paragraphs.en: Navigation is a substantially harder benchmark than it may superficially appear, for three compounding reasons that collectively demand multi-turn, reflective agent behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 导航这一基准测试实际上比其表面看起来要困难得多，这有三个相互叠加的原因，这些原因共同要求智能体具备多轮、反思性的行为。

paragraphs.en: (i) Dense waypoint sets require long-horizon, sequentially dependent tool use. Each instance contains 3 3 – 9 9 reference waypoints, and the success criterion requires that all of them be resolved to coordinates before any direction call may be issued (a hard rule enforced by the evaluator).
paragraphs.zh: (i) 密集的路点集需要长时程、顺序依赖的工具使用。 每个实例包含 3 到 9 个参考路点，成功标准要求在所有方向调用发出之前，必须将这些路点全部解析为坐标（这是评估器强制执行的一条硬性规则）。

paragraphs.zh: (ii) 模糊的地点名称需要多轮思考与自适应的重新查询。 真实 Amap 的 POI 名称并非唯一：同一个字面名称通常会对应多个地理位置相距较远的候选地点，而标准“正确”的候选地点是由周围的途经点上下文决定的，而非仅凭名称本身。 一个称职的智能体必须能够识别出 poi_search 的返回结果与行程其余部分不一致的情况，并重新发起搜索，同时加入更精确的区域限制。

paragraphs.en: Claw-Eval-Hard20 is a hard test set of 20 tasks drawn from the T-series tasks of Claw-Eval ( Ye et al., 2026 ) , a human-verified benchmark whose tasks are grounded in real-world environments and require autonomous tool use. Each task presents an open-ended request that the agent must complete by issuing Web tool calls and reading documents over a long interaction horizon, and the selected tasks span multi-step tool orchestration, failure recovery, cross-source synthesis, entity disambiguation, safety-sensitive decisions, document understanding, and numerical reasoning. The subset is deliberately constructed to be simultaneously difficult , solvable , and reliably evaluable : the base policy rarely discovers successful trajectories on it despite sufficient accessible information and valid evaluation signals, so failures reflect genuine capability limits rather than environment artifacts. Claw-Eval-Hard20 thereby directly tests the exploration bottleneck motivating RTI.
paragraphs.zh: Claw-Eval-Hard20 是一个包含 20 项任务的困难测试集，这些任务选自 Claw-Eval 的 T 系列任务（Ye 等人，2026），该基准经过人类验证，其任务均基于真实世界环境，并要求智能体能够自主使用工具。 每项任务都提出一个开放式的请求，智能体必须通过发出网络工具调用并在长时间交互过程中阅读文档来完成；所选任务涵盖了多步骤工具协同、故障恢复、跨源合成、实体消歧、安全性敏感决策、文档理解以及数值推理。 该子集经过刻意设计，使其同时具备困难性、可解性和可靠的评估性：尽管拥有充足的可获取信息和有效的评估信号，基础策略很少能在此测试集中找到成功的路径，因此失败反映的是真实的能力限制，而非环境因素造成的干扰。 因此，Claw-Eval-Hard20 直接检验了推动 RTI 发展的探索瓶颈问题。

paragraphs.en: A low success rate on the original benchmark does not necessarily indicate a genuine capability bottleneck. In the original Claw-Eval ( Ye et al., 2026 ) , some tasks are effectively infeasible under the evaluation environment: required evidence may be inaccessible through the available Web tools, become outdated over time, or be truncated by the context-length and tool-output limits. Other tasks contain brittle graders for which semantically correct answers may still fail. Including such tasks would conflate capability-limited failures with environment-limited failures . We therefore construct Claw-Eval-Hard20 as a subset of robustly evaluable hard tasks, paired with aligned synthetic training data.
paragraphs.zh: 原始基准测试中的低成功率并不一定意味着存在真正的能力瓶颈。 在原始的 Claw-Eval（Ye et al., 2026）中，某些任务在评估环境下实际上无法完成：所需的证据可能无法通过可用的网络工具获取，可能随时间而过时，也可能因上下文长度和工具输出限制而被截断。 其他任务则包含脆弱的评分机制，语义上正确的答案仍可能被判为错误。 将这类任务纳入评估会将能力受限导致的失败与环境限制导致的失败混为一谈。 因此，我们构建 Claw-Eval-Hard20 作为一组能够稳健评估的困难任务的子集，并搭配经过对齐的合成训练数据。

sents.zh: 其他任务则包含脆弱的评分机制，语义上正确的答案仍可能被判为错误。

sents.en: Including such tasks would conflate capability-limited failures with environment-limited failures .
sents.zh: 将这类任务纳入评估会将能力受限导致的失败与环境限制导致的失败混为一谈。

sents.en: We therefore construct Claw-Eval-Hard20 as a subset of robustly evaluable hard tasks, paired with aligned synthetic training data.
sents.zh: 因此，我们构建 Claw-Eval-Hard20 作为一组能够稳健评估的困难任务的子集，并搭配经过对齐的合成训练数据。

paragraphs.en: Second, we audit the feasibility of each candidate under the actual evaluation environment. Third, we manually inspect the remaining tasks to verify that (i) the request is well-defined, (ii) a valid solution can be obtained using the available observations and tools, (iii) the grader matches the intended task semantics, and (iv) failure primarily reflects an agentic capability deficit.

paragraphs.en: Training-data synthesis. The 20 original tasks are reserved exclusively for evaluation. To provide aligned training signals without exposing the test instances, we treat each selected task as a task family and generate eight structure-preserving variants, resulting in 160 synthetic training instances. Each variant retains the original task’s tool set, interaction structure, capability requirements, and grading logic, while replacing its entities, dates, numerical values, environment states, documents, and surface realization. The resulting train and test sets therefore share the same underlying capabilities but contain no overlapping instances.

paragraphs.en: We adopt a hybrid programmatic–LLM generation procedure. Programmatic generators construct all correctness-critical elements, including environment fixtures, entity relations, numerical constraints, and ground-truth answers. Qwen3.5-397B-A17B is used only to diversify scenario descriptions and linguistic realizations. This separation allows the LLM to improve linguistic diversity while ensuring that task semantics and evaluation targets remain deterministic.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用了一种程序化与 LLM 相结合的生成流程。 程序化生成器负责构建所有对正确性至关重要的元素，包括环境设置、实体关系、数值约束以及基准答案。 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 仅用于丰富场景描述和语言表现形式。 这种分离使得 LLM 能够在提升语言多样性的同时，确保任务语义和评估目标保持确定性。

paragraphs.en: Finally, every synthetic instance undergoes three quality checks. We execute a reference trajectory under the same tool environment and grader used for training, requiring a score of at least 0.99 0.99 to establish solvability. We then verify consistency among the instruction, environment fixtures, ground-truth constants, and grader. Near-duplicate prompts are further removed using character-level and trigram-based similarity thresholds. Only instances that are executable, evaluator-consistent, and sufficiently diverse are included in the final training set.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，每个合成实例都会经过三次质量检查。 我们在训练时使用的相同工具环境和评分器中执行一条参考轨迹，要求得分至少为 0.99 0.99，以确认其可解性。 接着，我们验证指令、环境配置、真实值常量和评分器之间的一致性。 使用字符级和三元组相似性阈值进一步移除近重复提示。 只有可执行、与评估器一致且足够多样化的实例才会被纳入最终训练集。

paragraphs.en: Claw-Eval-Hard20 stresses agentic policies along three compounding dimensions.
paragraphs.zh: Claw-Eval-Hard20 从三个相互叠加的维度对智能体策略进行压力测试。

paragraphs.en: (i) Extremely sparse positive feedback. All 20 selected tasks have a base-policy Pass@3 of at most 1 / 3 1/3 , and 17 are never solved in any of the three rollouts (Table 5 ). Standard on-policy RL therefore observes an all-zero reward on 17 of the 20 tasks, leaving the policy essentially no successful experience to bootstrap from.
paragraphs.zh: (i) 极其稀疏的正向反馈。 所有 20 个选中任务的基策略 Pass@3 最多为 1 / 3 1/3，其中 17 个任务在任何一次三次 rollout 中均从未被解决（表 5）。 因此，标准的 on-policy RL 在这 20 个任务中的 17 个上观察到全零奖励，导致策略基本上没有可用于初始启动的成功经验。

sents.en: (i) Extremely sparse positive feedback.
sents.zh: (i) 极其稀疏的正向反馈。

sents.en: All 20 selected tasks have a base-policy Pass@3 of at most 1 / 3 1/3 , and 17 are never solved in any of the three rollouts (Table 5 ).

paragraphs.en: (ii) Heterogeneous long-horizon task composition. The 20 tasks jointly cover multi-step tool orchestration, failure recovery, cross-source synthesis, entity disambiguation, safety-sensitive decisions, document understanding, and numerical reasoning. Solving them requires sustained tool use over long interaction horizons and large contexts, so a policy cannot succeed by repeating a single skill pattern; it must plan, verify, and revise its behavior across many steps.
paragraphs.zh: (ii) 异构长周期任务构成。 这 20 项任务共同涵盖了多步骤工具协同、故障恢复、跨源合成、实体消歧、安全敏感决策、文档理解和数值推理。 解决这些问题需要在较长的交互周期和大规模上下文中持续使用工具，因此策略不能通过重复单一技能模式来成功；它必须规划、验证并修正其行为，贯穿多个步骤。

paragraphs.en: (iii) Strict, safety-gated success criterion. A task is counted as passed only if its task score exceeds 0.75 0.75 under a rubric that multiplies the weighted completion and robustness terms by a safety factor, so unsafe behavior overrides partial task progress. The benchmark therefore gives no credit to trajectories that are superficially complete but non-compliant.
paragraphs.zh: (iii) 严格且受安全机制约束的成功标准。 仅当任务得分在评分体系下超过 0.75 时，该任务才算通过；此评分体系将加权完成度和稳健性项乘以安全系数，因此不安全行为会覆盖部分任务进展。 因此，该基准测试不会为那些表面上看似完成但实际不符合要求的轨迹给予任何分数。

paragraphs.en: GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) : a policy optimization method with group-normalized advantages.
paragraphs.zh: GRPO（Shao 等人，2024）：一种采用组归一化优势的策略优化方法。

paragraphs.en: GSPO ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) : a sequence-level RL method that uses sequence-likelihood importance ratios and sequence-level clipping instead of token-level importance weighting, improving optimization efficiency and training stability.
paragraphs.zh: GSPO（Zheng 等人，2025）：一种序列级强化学习方法，它使用序列似然重要性比率及序列级裁剪，而非词元级重要性加权，从而提升了优化效率和训练稳定性。

paragraphs.en: AEPO ( Dong et al., 2026a ) : an agentic-RL-specific method that addresses the instability caused by high-entropy tool-use decisions in long-horizon, multi-turn settings through entropy-balanced rollout scheduling and entropy-aware policy optimization, improving both exploration quality and training stability.
paragraphs.zh: AEPO（Dong 等人，2026a）：一种专为智能体强化学习设计的方法，通过熵平衡的展开调度与熵感知策略优化，解决了长期多轮设置中因高熵工具使用决策而导致的稳定性问题，从而提升了探索质量与训练稳定性。

sents.zh: 在训练过程中引入更强教师模型以指导策略模型的方法：

paragraphs.en: OPD ( Lu & Thinking Machines Lab, 2025 ) : on-policy distillation whose goal is to push the student distribution toward the teacher’s. Trajectories are generated by the policy model itself, and the stronger teacher scores these student trajectories at the token level; the teacher’s token-level scores are used as weights on the advantage term, so the update signal that pulls the student toward the teacher is computed on the student’s own on-policy data. Our implementation follows the mechanism of the slime framework 13 13 13 https://github.com/THUDM/slime , computing the per-token teacher signal and folding it into the advantage.
paragraphs.zh: OPD（Lu & Thinking Machines Lab，2025）：一种在线策略蒸馏方法，其目标是将学生模型的分布向教师模型靠拢。 轨迹由策略模型本身生成，而能力更强的教师模型会在词元级别对这些学生轨迹进行评分；教师模型在词元级别的评分被用作优势项的权重，因此将学生模型向教师模型拉拢的更新信号是基于学生模型自身的在线策略数据计算的。 我们的实现遵循了 slime 框架 13 13 13 https://github.com/THUDM/slime 的机制，计算每个词元的教师信号并将其整合到优势项中。

paragraphs.en: LUFFY ( Yan et al., 2026 ) : an off-policy RL approach that augments the policy’s own rollouts with teacher-generated trajectories. Concretely, whenever an entire rollout group fails—all trajectories in the group receive zero reward—we replace the failed group with successful trajectories generated by the stronger teacher model on the same task, so that the policy can still obtain positive learning signals on tasks beyond its unaided capability.
paragraphs.zh: LUFFY（Yan 等，2026）：一种离策略强化学习方法，它通过教师模型生成的轨迹来增强策略自身的 rollout。 具体来说，每当一个完整的 rollout 组失败时——即该组中的所有轨迹都获得零奖励——我们会用更强教师模型在同一任务上生成的成功轨迹来替换这个失败的组，这样策略仍然能够在其无辅助能力之外的任务中获得正向的学习信号。

paragraphs.en: Overall, this example shows how MAS-based intervention converts an otherwise failed rollout into a valid and learnable trajectory by correcting the decisive local error while preserving the policy’s original reasoning direction.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，这个例子展示了基于多智能体系统（MAS）的干预如何将原本失败的部署转化为有效且可学习的轨迹：它在纠正关键局部错误的同时，保留了策略原有的推理方向。

paragraphs.en: To isolate the role of the leakage-suppression clause in the Corrector, we contrast two intervened rollouts of the same task from τ 2 \tau^{2} -Telecom.
paragraphs.zh: 为了明确 Corrector 中泄漏抑制条款的作用，我们对来自 τ 2 \tau^{2} -Telecom 的同一任务的两种干预式执行过程进行了对比。

paragraphs.en: This example illustrates why leakage suppression is necessary in the Corrector. Even when the high-level repair direction is correct, a ground-truth-aware corrector may still overfit to hidden supervision and verbalize backend-only information that should never appear in the rollout. Such responses are deceptively successful: they satisfy the task outcome, yet violate the answer-concealment requirement and distort the trajectory distribution away from the policy’s natural reasoning process. The Verifier therefore rejects this intervened response as an invalid training signal.
paragraphs.zh: 这个例子说明了为什么在修正器中需要抑制信息泄露。 即使高层修复方向正确，一个了解真实答案的修正器仍可能过度拟合于隐式监督，并说出本不应出现在推理过程中的、仅属于后端的信息。 这类响应看似成功：它们满足了任务结果的要求，但却违反了隐藏答案的要求，并使轨迹分布偏离了策略的自然推理过程。 因此，验证器将这种经过干预的响应视为无效的训练信号而予以拒绝。

paragraphs.en: This contrasting example shows the intended behavior of the full RTI pipeline. Leakage suppression prevents the Corrector from exposing hidden labels or backend-derived facts, while still allowing it to repair the decisive local mistake. The resulting response remains close to the policy’s original intent, uses only visible evidence, and converts the failed action into a valid user-guiding continuation. Such trajectories are both successful and learnable, making them appropriate for downstream policy optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 这个对比示例展示了完整 RTI 流程的预期行为。 泄漏抑制机制可防止校正器暴露隐藏标签或来自后端的事实，同时仍能使其修复决定性的局部错误。 最终生成的响应仍与策略的原始意图相近，仅使用可见的证据，并将失败的动作转化为有效的用户引导性后续操作。 这类轨迹既成功又可被学习，因此适合用于下游的策略优化。

paragraphs.en: This subsection provides the full trajectory-level comparison for the Navigation example. We highlight the key behavioral difference: GRPO recognizes the retrieved POI is abnormal but still proceeds to a malformed direction call, whereas RTI re-queries with a refined region and only then issues the correct direction call .
paragraphs.zh: 本小节提供了导航示例中完整的轨迹级对比。 我们重点指出关键的行为差异：GRPO 虽然识别出检索到的 POI 异常，但仍继续执行格式错误的方向调用；而 RTI 则会先以优化后的区域重新查询，之后才会发出正确的方向调用。

sents.zh: 本小节提供了导航示例中完整的轨迹级对比。

sents.en: We highlight the key behavioral difference: GRPO recognizes the retrieved POI is abnormal but still proceeds to a malformed direction call, whereas RTI re-queries with a refined region and only then issues the correct direction call .
sents.zh: 我们重点指出关键的行为差异：GRPO 虽然识别出检索到的 POI 异常，但仍继续执行格式错误的方向调用；而 RTI 则会先以优化后的区域重新查询，之后才会发出正确的方向调用。

paragraphs.en: Under GRPO, the agent follows the familiar search–direction–response template. After a name-based search returns a semantically matched but geographically incorrect destination in Beijing, the agent verbally notices the inconsistency but still directly calls direction using the wrong destination coordinates, leading to failure.
paragraphs.zh: 在 GRPO 框架下，智能体遵循熟悉的“搜索–方向–响应”模板。 当基于名称的搜索返回一个语义匹配但地理位置错误的北京目的地后，智能体虽然口头指出了这一不一致之处，但仍直接使用错误的目的地坐标调用方向功能，最终导致失败。

sents.en: Under GRPO, the agent follows the familiar search–direction–response template.
sents.zh: 在 GRPO 框架下，智能体遵循熟悉的“搜索–方向–响应”模板。

sents.en: After a name-based search returns a semantically matched but geographically incorrect destination in Beijing, the agent verbally notices the inconsistency but still directly calls direction using the wrong destination coordinates, leading to failure.
sents.zh: 当基于名称的搜索返回一个语义匹配但地理位置错误的北京目的地后，智能体虽然口头指出了这一不一致之处，但仍直接使用错误的目的地坐标调用方向功能，最终导致失败。

paragraphs.en: Under RTI, the agent reacts differently to the same wrong initial retrieval. Instead of prematurely committing to route planning, it treats the Beijing result as evidence of search ambiguity, refines the query with a region hint, and only then issues the final direction call with the correct destination.
paragraphs.zh: 在 RTI 机制下，智能体对相同的错误初始检索结果会做出不同的反应。 它不会过早地锁定路线规划，而是将北京这一结果视为搜索存在歧义的证据，通过添加区域提示来优化查询，之后才会发出包含正确目的地的最终路线请求。

sents.en: To illustrate what this mechanism highlights in practice, we provide a visualization on the τ 2 \tau^{2} -Telecom domain in Figure 7 .
sents.zh: 为了说明该机制在实践中突出显示的内容，我们在图 7 中提供了 τ 2 \tau^{2} -Telecom 领域的可视化展示。

paragraphs.en: The darkest tokens correspond to local edits that materially alter the reasoning trajectory, such as a contrastive marker (“ Instead ”), which signals a switch in action plan; an explicit acknowledgment of an action constraint (“ cannot perform … for them ”), which corrects the agent’s role boundary; and the redirected action target (“ guide the user to re-insert ”), which specifies the repaired strategy. By selectively amplifying such tokens during optimization, reasoning-shift reweighting improves credit assignment to the decisive local edits, thereby making the learning signal from corrected trajectories more focused and effective.
paragraphs.zh: 最暗色的词元对应那些实质性改变推理路径的局部编辑，例如对比标记（“Instead”），它标志着行动计划的转变；对行动约束的明确承认（“cannot perform … for them”），它修正了智能体的角色边界；以及被重新引导的行动目标（“guide the user to re-insert”），它明确了修复后的策略。 通过在优化过程中选择性地放大这类词元，推理转移的重新加权能够提升对决定性局部编辑的归因准确性，从而使得来自修正后推理路径的学习信号更加集中且有效。

paragraphs.en: The training data of Claw-Eval-Hard20 are synthesized variants of the same 20 task families that constitute the test set, so the results in Section 5.5 primarily measure generalization within the target families. paragraphs.en: Overall, these results demonstrate that RTI generalizes beyond the task families used for training-data synthesis. On Hard20-ID, Pass@1 rises from 26.25 (base) to 85.00, far above GRPO (52.50). More importantly, the gains carry over to the out-of-distribution Rest-OOD tasks, whose task families never contribute to the training-data synthesis: RTI improves Pass@1 from 54.34 to 62.92 and avg Pass k from 43.62 to 54.48 over the base policy, remains ahead of GRPO on all three metrics, and lifts the full-suite Pass@1 from 51.51 to 65.20. The comparatively modest Rest-OOD gains should not be read as weaker transfer. Rest-OOD is reported without any difficulty screening, and, as analyzed in Appendix C.2.3 , a non-trivial fraction of Claw-Eval tasks are effectively infeasible or not reliably evaluable under the evaluation environment (e.g., evidence that is inaccessible or outdated, context-length and tool-output limits, or brittle graders that reject semantically correct answers). Environment-limited failures of this kind cap the attainable scores and make the numbers above conservative, indicating that on the tasks that are in fact solvable RTI has essentially reached the ceiling achievable under the evaluation environment. We attribute this transfer mainly to improved reflection and reasoning: the corrected trajectories teach the model to detect inconsistencies in its own reasoning and to revise its plan accordingly, rather than memorize task-specific solutions, so the acquired multi-step reflective behavior carries over to tasks it has never seen.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，这些结果表明 RTI 的泛化能力超越了用于训练数据合成的任务类别。 在 Hard20-ID 上，Pass@1 从 26.25（基线）提升至 85.00，远高于 GRPO（52.50）。 更重要的是，这种提升也延续到了分布外的 Rest-OOD 任务上——这些任务的类别从未用于训练数据合成：与基线策略相比，RTI 将 Pass@1 从 54.34 提升至 62.92，平均 Pass k 从 43.62 提升至 54.48；在所有三项指标上均优于 GRPO，并将完整测试套的 Pass@1 从 51.51 提升至 65.20。 Rest-OOD 任务上相对有限的提升不应被解读为迁移效果较弱。 Rest-OOD 的结果未经任何难度筛选；正如附录 C.2.3 所分析的，Claw-Eval 中相当一部分任务在评估环境中实际上无法完成或难以可靠评估（例如，证据不可获取或已过时、上下文长度和工具输出限制，或会拒绝语义正确答案的脆弱评分机制）。 这类由环境限制导致的失败会限制可获得的分数，使上述数据显得保守；这表明在那些确实可解的任务上，RTI 已基本达到了评估环境下的性能上限。 我们将这种迁移效果主要归因于反思与推理能力的提升：修正后的轨迹教会模型检测自身推理中的不一致性并据此调整计划，而非单纯记忆特定任务的解决方案，因此所获得的跨步骤反思行为能够迁移到其从未见过的任务中。
